---
title: "Demo: R Markdown file"
output: html_document
---

This is an **R Markdown** file. It is Markdown **plus** executable
R code chunks, so text, code, and results live in one document.

```{r summary}
mtcars
avg_mpg <- aggregate(mpg ~ cyl, data = mtcars, FUN = mean)
avg_mpg
```

The table above is generated when the document is rendered, so it
never goes stale. Plots work the same way:

```{r plot, fig.height = 3}
barplot(
  avg_mpg$mpg,
  names.arg = avg_mpg$cyl,
  xlab = "Cylinders",
  ylab = "Mean MPG"
)
```

Inline code works too: the overall mean MPG is
`r round(mean(mtcars$mpg), 1)`.
